kind: Published ic-host 0.4.0 adoption for existing Backup-owned contracts
published_review: Both cached registry archive digests match the incoming Cargo.lock; every published Rust source matches the clean exact release commit. No copied implementation, sibling write or local dependency patch.
catalog: Maintainer-selected 0.4 manifest requirements and 0.4.0 locked packages retained unchanged. Default features disabled; no optional archive, gzip, wasm or process dependency.

compatibility.reason: The upstream minor release removes readers and lock helpers that Backup does not use. Its ArtifactError conversion replaces private equivalent mappings; no upstream public Rust type identity is exposed by these owners. Backup signatures/error variants, v1 bytes, digest values, allowances and retained references are unchanged.
compatibility.metadata: Workspace/package version and released receipt remain 0.5.1; incoming host and metrics manifest/lock selections are unchanged.
compatibility.retained_data: No migration, journal reset or artifact regeneration.

errors: Shared From<ArtifactError> preserves native io::Error identity and retains non-native typed causes. Product-specific NotRegularFile -> InvalidInput, LimitExceeded -> original RecordTooLarge or FileShape, and IcSnapshotArtifactError::Artifact wrapping remain at their original boundaries. CopyError still distinguishes input and output; partial output survives.
limits: Existing u64::MAX raw artifact stream budgets, exact IC extent/checksum counts, 1 MiB chunk limit and caller-selected JSON u64 byte limits are unchanged. Required record reads retain final NOFOLLOW/NONBLOCK descriptor admission; missing files remain errors, not optional regeneration.
custody: Shared path locks block and durably create parent paths, unlike Backup nonblocking contention refusal, existing-file acquisition and owned descendant descriptor custody. Shared generic publication does not preserve all private permissions and retained crash barriers. Local descriptor-relative traversal, original identity checks, staging, synchronization and publication stay with their existing owners. Optional/private readers are not needed by these callers; process capture is not command-custody replacement.
msrv: Both host packages declare Rust 1.88.0; Backup remains Rust 1.91.0, edition 2024.
license: MIT registry dependencies; no source copied. Existing extraction attribution retained.

qualification.scope: Fresh affected artifact hashing/copy/unsafe traversal, bounded JSON and private crash publication, exact IC artifact verification/upload, current metrics and four public local recovery/source/artifact/upload journeys on Linux. Configured all-target/all-feature Clippy, Rust 1.91 compilation, locked offline package and focused repository contract checks. Native macOS delivery and broad release gate remain pending. No actual IC effect qualification inferred.
qualification.initial_failure: tests-00-initial-import-failure.log retains the test module dependency on a removed production io import. Tests now import std::io explicitly; all focused cases pass.

prior_qualification: Older 0.5.0/0.5.1 archive, consumer and native evidence retains its actual dependency graph; it is not relabelled as 0.4.0 qualification.
remaining: Native delivery for the complete uncommitted 0.5.2 draft remains independent. No transport, runner, live effect, paid retry, fresh authority or terminal/reference/fence release is added.
